checks.detail: Runtime lane (native.host.0/1): build, window/renderer checks, product_ui_separation=pass, embedded assets, anonymous validation replay via WebDriver, screenshots, clean session close, source/binary unchanged — all pass. Unit surface: 20/20 rust-unit (auth/persistence, rate limit, private-op rejection, single-use tokens, reminder exactly-once, schema upgrade, in-process section-3 self-drive); tsc/vite/fmt/check clean. Visual: bound captures show a section-9-conformant auth shell. Risk-handoff fixes verified: #golden-path-probe renders and the collector reads it (candidate_report total=16 state=idle); trigger-only start, zero navigator.webdriver references; reminder-email booleans enforced backend-side. FAIL axis: the PRD 3/11 signed-in journey is unobserved through the live UI for a 7th loop — the bound replay drove only the anonymous smoke; no signed-in surface or 9.2 state was ever captured; external focusboard:// activation unproven. Bottleneck is now collector-bound: the replay never clicks #golden-path-trigger and golden_path_observation() hardcodes state=unavailable, so the registered lane cannot conclude pass for any candidate. Advisory gaps stay inconclusive, not product signals. prd.section3=insufficient_evidence; prd.section8=insufficient_evidence; prd.section9.2=insufficient_evidence; prd.section9=pass; auth.deep-link=insufficient_evidence; evidence.gate.golden-path=insufficient_evidence; advisory.persistence=insufficient_evidence; advisory.whitebox=insufficient_evidence; quality.rustfmt=pass; security.regression=pass; quality.unit=pass

output_contract.risk_handoff_policy: Risk context is host-owned and must be echoed through bindings; Tester should explicitly inspect the stated validation result and cite bound evidence when risk remains unresolved.

required_criteria.requirement: Review candidate-bound runtime, interface, persistence, security, and visual evidence against the PRD.

developer_outcome.summary: Both host-mandated fixes verified in source (no navigator.webdriver auto-start; runDrive honors golden_path_check_reminder_email booleans) and the unit environment is green, but acceptance requires the host-owned native-webdriver receipt reading data-goldenpath-state, not runnable from this session. Reported not_validated for Tester replay; not a blocker per the retry contract.

risk_note.summary: The replay could still conclude golden_path.state=unavailable if the probe wiring or trigger path does not match what the registered gate reads, or if the self-drive fails mid-flow on a step the unit environment masked.
risk_note.validation: The most likely insufficient-evidence outcome is a unit-level pass claim without a registered runtime receipt; acceptance therefore requires the focusboard-native-webdriver receipt itself reading data-goldenpath-state, not unit results or screenshots alone.
risk_note.why_now: Five loops of harness-side attempts ended at the anonymous shell and loop-06 changed only Rust files, so the renderer instrumentation gap is now the single pinned blocking root cause and must change strategy this loop.
